name: Nikasios
description: A handsome, skilled spearman of the squad who loses a leg to the minotaur leader but stays to hold the line.

timeline.summary: A wounded cyclops attacks the squad; Pallas is backhanded, and the squad kills it with Mnesos's sling and Nikasios's spear.
timeline.quote: There was a crack as Mnesos's stone met the cyclops's skull, and the creature roared.

timeline.summary: Nikasios notices the cyclops's other leg was mauled rather than cut, and Kyrillos decides to investigate One-Eyed Pass since Eumalos's squad missed the rendezvous.
timeline.quote: there's something besides our soldiers in One-Eyed Pass that can drive off a cyclops. We're going to check it out.

timeline.summary: The minotaur leader joins the fight, severs Nikasios's leg and hurls Haemon against the canyon wall with a sickening crack.
timeline.quote: Nikasios lurched to one side, but the minotaur struck his leg, severing it.

timeline.summary: Pallas, injured, and the wounded Diocles and Nikasios stay to hold off more minotaurs while Leandros climbs out to warn Akros.
timeline.quote: Then more minotaurs poured into the canyon, and Leandros turned to climb the tumbled boulders.
